arStrings.szText: "He did...something to me. Or tried to."
That much is apparent. But I suspect there is more to this than we can see.
I would speak to you more. But not in this place.
I don’t know this woman. Who is she? How does she know so much about demons?
I am called Sayeena. I’m a historian. A collector of rare artifacts and scriptures. I’ve studied demons and their patterns since... I’ve studied them for many years.
Demons are meant to be slain, not studied.
Ignorance is the true danger, not knowledge.
There is much more to discuss, but not here. Come to my shop in Tarsarak.
